title: ABACUS HSE crashes in center2_orb: Sph_Bessel_Recursive cache keeps stale rows on reuse
symptom: MnTe DZP HSE (nspin=2) SCF asserts inside center2_orb within tens of seconds.
root_cause: Two layers: DZP orbitals use Mesh=1001 (odd) but Matrix_Orbs11/21/22 sized the table as kmesh*kmesh_times+1 (=1002, even) while change_orbs/construct_abfs paths force odd via |1; and Sph_Bessel_Recursive::D2 refreshed only the requested ix1_size rows on cache reuse, leaving larger-Rmesh rows with the old kmesh width, which asserts on later access.
minimal_fix: Fix the cache refresh in sph_bessel_recursive-d2.cpp to invalidate/resize all cached rows, keep center2_orb call sites clean, and add a minimal reproduction unit test.
validation: Rebuilt binary passed the previously fatal point and the job completed.
avoid: Patching call sites to dodge the assert while the cache stays stale.

parameters.abacus_fix: invalidate all cached Sph_Bessel_Recursive rows on reuse
